div.head: VI As 8.3
div.ab: ⁊ eac sendan on twa healfa to þam gerefum ⁊ wilnian tó heom fultum be swa manegum mannum, swa us þonne cínelic þince æt swa micelre spræce, þæt þam forworhtum mannum beo þe mara ége for ure gesomnunge; ⁊ we ridan ealle to ⁊ urne téonan wrécan ⁊ þone þeof lecgean ⁊ þa þe him midfeohtan ⁊ standan, buton hig him framgán willan.

Et etiam mittamus hinc et inde ad prepositos et queramus auxilium ab eis, de quot hominibus tunc uidebitur competens, ut homo forisfactus magis timeat; et accedamus simul et uindicemus molestiam nostram et furem occidamus et qui cum eo pugnabunt et stabunt, nisi discedant ab eo.

⁊ eac sendan on twa healfa to þam gerefum, ⁊ wilnian tó heom fultum be swa manegum mannum swa us þonne cínelec þince æt swa micelre spræce, þæt þam forworhtum mannum beo þe mara ége for ure gesomnunge; ⁊ we ridan ealle to ⁊ urne téonan wrécan ⁊ þone þeof lecgean ⁊ þa þe him midfeohtan ⁊ standan, buton hig him framgán willan.

And in addition, we shall send to the reeves in both directions, requesting from them the help of as many men as seems desirable, according to the seriousness of the case, that wrongdoers may be the more afraid of us because of our numbers. And we shall all ride out against them, and avenge the wrong done to us, and slay the thief and those who support him and fight on his behalf — unless they are willing to forsake him.

und auch nach beiden Seiten zu den [Grafschafts]vögten hinsenden und bei ihnen Hilfe durch so viele Mannschaft erbitten, wie uns dann bei so wichtiger Rechtssache passend dünkt, auf dass jenen schuldbeladenen Leuten um so grössere Furcht vor unserer Ansammlung entstehe; und [dass] wir alle hinzureiten und die uns [angethane] Schädigung rächen und den Dieb niederschlagen und die, welche ihm zur Seite fechten und beistehen, es sei denn, sie wollen von ihm weichen.

and also send to the [shire-]reeves on both sides and ask them for help from as many men as then seems fitting to us in so important a case, so that those guilty men may have all the greater fear of our gathering; and [that] we all ride there and avenge the injury [done] to us and strike down the thief and those who fight and stand beside him, unless they are willing to depart from him.
